t2.title: Governments invest more in public transportation
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should governments invest more in public transportation?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Public transportation is essential for modern cities. I firmly believe governments should invest more in public transit systems.

Firstly, improved public transport reduces traffic congestion. When buses and trains are reliable and affordable, fewer people drive. Cities like Tokyo and Singapore demonstrate how excellent transit networks minimize gridlock.

Secondly, public transportation benefits the environment. Buses and trains produce far less carbon emissions per passenger than private cars. Investing in electric buses and metro systems helps cities meet climate targets.

However, critics argue that infrastructure costs are enormous. Building metro lines requires billions. Nevertheless, the long-term economic benefits outweigh initial investments through increased productivity and reduced healthcare costs from pollution.

Furthermore, affordable public transport promotes social equality. Many people cannot afford cars, so reliable transit ensures everyone can access jobs, education, and services.

In conclusion, governments should prioritize public transportation investment. It creates cleaner, fairer, and more efficient cities for all residents.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi CityWheels!

Bikes good. Easy to use. Stations good. More bikes, please!

Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Dear CityWheels,

I liked the bikes. They were fun. The stations were easy to find, and the bikes were good to ride. But maybe you need more bikes because sometimes there were no bikes at the station. Also, a map would be good. Thank you!

Thanks,
Aziz Nazarov
t2.sampleB1:
Dear CityWheels Team,

Thank you for the opportunity to rent your bikes during my vacation. Overall, I had a positive experience, but there are a few things that could be improved. The bikes were generally in good condition, and the rental process was straightforward. The pickup and return stations were conveniently located in most areas I visited.

However, sometimes it was difficult to find available bikes at popular stations during peak hours. I think it would be helpful to have more bikes available, especially in tourist areas. Also, a mobile app with real-time bike availability would be very useful.

In my opinion, adding bike racks in less central locations would encourage more people to explore different parts of the city. Perhaps offering discounts for longer rental periods could also attract more customers. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Aziz Nazarov
t2.sampleB2: Should Governments Put Public Transport First? Picture your morning commute without the endless queues of traffic, the fumes, and the frustration. It sounds too good to be true, yet greater investment in public transport could make it an everyday reality. First of all, well-funded buses and trains take thousands of cars off the road. Cities such as Vienna and Singapore prove that when transport is cheap and reliable, people are more than happy to leave their cars at home, and traffic jams ease as a result. On top of that, public transport is far kinder to the planet. A packed train produces only a fraction of the emissions that dozens of private cars would, so channelling money into cleaner metros helps governments hit their climate targets. Admittedly, laying new tracks costs a fortune and the rewards take time to show. Even so, the pay-off is enormous: less pollution, fewer accidents, and a city where everyone can get around regardless of income. All things considered, spending more on public transport is money well spent. It is an investment in cleaner air and a brighter future for us all.
t2.uzSample:
Jamoat transporti zamonaviy shaharlar uchun muhim ahamiyatga ega. Men hukumatlar jamoat transporti tizimlariga ko'proq sarmoya kiritishi kerak, deb qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, yaxshilangan jamoat transporti tirbandlikni kamaytiradi. Avtobus va poyezdlar ishonchli va arzon bo'lganda, kamroq odam mashina haydaydi. Tokio va Singapur kabi shaharlar ajoyib transport tarmoqlari tirbandlikni qanday minimallashtirishini ko'rsatadi.

Ikkinchidan, jamoat transporti atrof-muhitga foyda keltiradi. Avtobus va poyezdlar har bir yo'lovchiga xususiy avtomobillarga qaraganda ancha kam karbonat angidrid gazini chiqaradi. Elektr avtobuslar va metro tizimlariga sarmoya kiritish shaharlarga iqlim maqsadlariga erishishga yordam beradi.

Biroq, tanqidchilar infratuzilma xarajatlari juda katta ekanligini ta'kidlaydilar. Metro liniyalarini qurish milliardlarni talab qiladi. Shunga qaramay, uzoq muddatli iqtisodiy foyda unumdorlikning oshishi va ifloslanishdan kelib chiqadigan sog'liqni saqlash xarajatlarining kamayishi orqali dastlabki investitsiyalardan ustun turadi.

Bundan tashqari, arzon jamoat transporti ijtimoiy tenglikni rag'batlantiradi. Ko'p odamlar mashina sotib olishga qurbi yetmaydi, shuning uchun ishonchli transport hamma uchun ish o'rinlari, ta'lim va xizmatlardan foydalanish imkoniyatini ta'minlaydi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, hukumatlar jamoat transportiga investitsiya kiritishga ustuvor ahamiyat berishlari kerak. Bu barcha aholi uchun yanada toza, adolatli va samarali shaharlarni yaratadi.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom, CityWheels!

Velosipedlar yaxshi. Ishlatish oson. Stansiyalar yaxshi. Iltimos, ko'proq velosipedlar bo'lsin!

Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Hurmatli CityWheels,

Menga velosipedlar yoqdi. Ular qiziqarli edi. Bekatlar topishga oson edi va velosipedlar minishga yaxshi edi. Lekin balki sizga ko'proq velosipedlar kerakdir, chunki ba'zida bekatda velosipedlar yo'q edi. Shuningdek, xarita ham yaxshi bo'lardi. Rahmat!

Rahmat,
Aziz Nazarov
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli CityWheels jamoasi,

Ta'tilim davomida sizning velosipedlaringizni ijaraga olish imkoniyati uchun rahmat. Umuman olganda, men ijobiy tajribaga ega bo'ldim, lekin yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta narsalar bor. Velosipedlar odatda yaxshi holatda edi va ijaraga olish jarayoni sodda edi. Olish va qaytarish stansiyalari men borgan ko'pgina joylarda qulay joylashgan edi.

Biroq, ba'zan gavjum soatlarda mashhur stansiyalarda bo'sh velosipedlarni topish qiyin edi. O'ylaymanki, ayniqsa sayyohlik joylarida ko'proq velosipedlar bo'lishi foydali bo'lardi. Shuningdek, real vaqtda velosipedlarning mavjudligini ko'rsatadigan mobil ilova juda foydali bo'lardi.

Mening fikrimcha, markaziy bo'lmagan joylarda velosiped tokchalarini qo'shish ko'proq odamlarni shaharning turli qismlarini o'rganishga undaydi. Ehtimol, uzoqroq ijara muddatlari uchun chegirmalar taklif qilish ham ko'proq mijozlarni jalb qilishi mumkin. E'tiboringiz uchun rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Aziz Nazarov
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli CityWheels jamoasi,

Men CityWheels velosiped ijarasi bilan yaqinda bo'lgan tajribam haqida fikr bildirish uchun yozyapman. Men bu xizmatni ta'tilim davomida qimmatli aktiv deb topdim, bu shaharni o'rganishning qulay va yoqimli usulini taklif qildi.

Velosipedlarning o'zi odatda yaxshi saqlangan edi va onlayn bron qilish tizimi foydalanuvchilar uchun qulay edi. Olish va qaytarish stantsiyalarining joylashuvi, asosan, juda qulay edi. Biroq, men ba'zi hollarda ayniqsa mashhur joylardagi stantsiyalarda velosipedlar tugab qolganiga duch keldim, bu esa menga mavjudini topish uchun uzoqroq yurishni talab qildi. Yanada dinamik qayta taqsimlash tizimi bu muammoni hal qilishi mumkin.

Yaxshilash nuqtai nazaridan, men ekskursiya velosiped turlarini taklif qilish imkoniyatini o'rganishni taklif qilaman, ehtimol, muayyan tarixiy yoki madaniy hududlarga e'tibor qaratgan holda. Bundan tashqari, mobil ilovangizga GPS kuzatuv va marshrutni rejalashtirish funksiyalarini kiritish foydalanuvchi tajribasini sezilarli darajada yaxshilaydi. Nihoyat, e-velosipedlar yoki bolalar o'rindiqli velosipedlar kabi velosiped turlarining kengroq assortimentini taklif qilish mijozlarning kengroq doirasiga xizmat qilishi mumkin.

Ushbu qimmatli xizmatni taqdim etganingiz uchun tashakkur. Menimcha, bir nechta yaxshilanishlar bilan CityWheels shahar transport infratuzilmasining yanada ajralmas qismiga aylanishi mumkin.

Hurmat bilan,
Aziz Nazarov

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is planning a trip to the same city. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I heard you're visiting Barcelona soon! I highly recommend renting bikes from CityWheels. It was such a fun way to explore! The bikes were in great condition and you can pick up and return them anywhere. You should definitely try it – much better than taxis! Take care!

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the bike rental service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear CityWheels Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your bike rental service. I was extremely pleased with the service. The rental process was quick and the app worked flawlessly. The bikes were well-maintained and very comfortable. The docking stations were conveniently located throughout the city. However, I have some suggestions. During peak hours, finding available bikes was sometimes difficult. Additionally, some tourist areas lacked return stations, forcing longer rides to find one. I would appreciate more electric bikes for hilly routes. A route suggestion feature in the app would help tourists discover scenic paths. Also, offering helmet rentals at stations would improve safety. Overall, CityWheels made exploring the city enjoyable. Yours sincerely, Aziz Nazarov
t12.sampleA1:
Hi CityWheels,
The bike is good. I like the bike. It is fun.
Thank you.
Bye,
Aziz Nazarov
t12.sampleA2:
Dear CityWheels,
I used your bikes. It was good. The bikes are nice and I like the city.
But sometimes no bikes. And the stations are far. I want more stations, please.
Thank you very much.
Best,
Aziz Nazarov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear CityWheels Team,

Thank you for your email. I rented a bike last week and it was mostly good. The bikes were easy to find and use. I think the prices are okay too.

However, I think you need more bikes. Sometimes I couldn't find one when I wanted to. Also, the stations are not always in the best places. It would be good to have more near the park.

Overall, I liked the service. Thank you.

Sincerely,
Aziz Nazarov
t12.sampleB2: Dear CityWheels Team, I am writing to share some feedback after using your bike rental service throughout a recent holiday in the city. On the whole, I was highly impressed. The rental process was quick and hassle-free, the mobile app ran smoothly, and every bike I hired was clean and well maintained. The docking stations were conveniently located across the centre, which made getting around a breeze. That said, there is room for improvement. At peak times, bikes were often in short supply at the busiest stations, and a couple of tourist spots had no return points nearby. I would strongly recommend adding more electric bikes for the steeper routes, along with a helmet rental option for extra safety. All in all, your service made my trip thoroughly enjoyable, and I hope these suggestions come in handy. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
